title: Web Application Security Roadmap
content: Core capabilities include HTTP fundamentals, browser security, authentication, authorization, session management, input validation, access control, API security, OWASP methodology, secure coding concepts, threat modeling, testing methodology, vulnerability reporting and remediation communication.

title: SOC Analyst Foundations
content: Foundational SOC skills include networking, operating systems, log analysis, SIEM concepts, detection engineering, incident triage, alert investigation, basic scripting, threat intelligence and incident response.

title: GRC Foundations
content: GRC work commonly includes risk assessment, policy development, control mapping, audit evidence, security frameworks, third-party risk, business continuity, compliance documentation and stakeholder communication.

title: Cloud Security Foundations
content: Cloud security foundations include identity and access management, network controls, logging and monitoring, secrets management, secure storage, workload security, infrastructure-as-code concepts and shared responsibility.

title: Security Portfolio Evidence
content: A strong cybersecurity portfolio can include sanitized vulnerability write-ups, lab reports, detection rules, threat models, secure architecture diagrams, automation scripts, policy samples and clearly documented projects. Do not publish sensitive client information.

title: Interview Preparation
content: Security interviews may assess fundamentals, scenario analysis, communication, methodology and practical reasoning. Prepare concise examples, explain assumptions, describe evidence and avoid claiming experience you do not have.

title: Learning Plan Design
content: Effective plans sequence foundations before advanced topics, combine learning with hands-on practice, create measurable weekly outcomes, and produce portfolio evidence. A 30/60/90-day structure can be used when appropriate.

title: Free Learning Strategy
content: When a user requests free learning, prioritize official documentation, open educational materials, reputable free courses, standards, public labs and vendor documentation. Verify current availability when a resource is time-sensitive.
